ev.q: The concept had the great advantage of being easy to understand and easy to act upon.

1.why: A段。B simple for ordinary people to grasp and apply ↔ easy to understand and easy to act upon。A 与原文相反：段末说研究者很快指出它 measured the wrong thing；C 原文只说 Several supermarkets began labelling，并非法律要求。

ev.q: For most foods, by far the largest share of emissions arises on the farm itself

2.why: B段。B Most emissions are generated before food leaves the farm ↔ by far the largest share of emissions arises on the farm itself。A 与 less than a tenth 相反；C 与 many times more 相反；D 张冠李戴——甲烷来自牛羊消化草料，不是化肥。

ev.q: Yet even sceptics acknowledged that its basic point, that where and how food is produced matters more than how far it travels, was sound.

3.why: C段末句。B central message was accepted even by those who doubted its details ↔ even sceptics acknowledged that its basic point … was sound。A 过度：批评者质疑的是假设，并未否定结论；C 偷换：批评者说的是关于英国农业的假设不被所有人接受，而不是研究忽略了英国做法；D 绝对化（always）。

ev.q: it means that distance is a poor guide to what matters most

4.why: 全文主旨：食物里程（距离）不能反映食物的气候影响，吃什么比从哪来更重要。B distance is a misleading guide ↔ distance is a poor guide to what matters most。A 过度：作者没有劝人只买进口食品，E段还肯定了本地食品的社会价值；C、D 只是局部例子。

ev.q: Transport, it found, accounted on average for less than a tenth of the total.

5.why: 5–7 题答案为 A、C、F（顺序不限）。A ↔ B段：运输平均只占总排放的不到十分之一。B 与D段相反（air freight carries only a tiny proportion）；G 与G段首句相反（None of this means that the distance food travels is irrelevant）。

ev.q: concluded that the imported meat had the lower carbon footprint

6.why: C ↔ C段：新西兰运来的羊肉、西班牙运来的番茄可能比本地生产排放更少（Distance can even mislead）。D 文中只说超市贴标签，没有说消费者不感兴趣；E 与E段相反（作者承认本地食品有社会价值）。

ev.q: a campaign that persuaded European shoppers to boycott air-freighted produce would fall hardest on some of the world's poorest farmers

7.why: F ↔ F段：抵制空运农产品会让最贫穷的农民受害最深。avoiding certain imports ↔ boycott air-freighted produce；farmers in poorer countries ↔ the world's poorest farmers / smallholders in East Africa。

ev.q: Several supermarkets began labelling products that had been flown in from abroad

8.why: A段。started to mark goods that had arrived by air ↔ began labelling products that had been flown in。I 是干扰：提议每件商品都标明运输距离的是 some campaigners，不是超市。

ev.q: by far the largest share of emissions arises on the farm itself: from fertiliser, from the methane produced by cattle and sheep as they digest grass, and from the clearing of forests to create pasture and cropland

9.why: B段。Clearances of forest for pasture and crops ↔ the clearing of forests to create pasture and cropland；它是农场阶段主要排放来源之一 ↔ are among the largest sources of emissions。E（需要大量化肥）不对：原文只是把化肥列为另一排放来源，并没有说毁林需要化肥。

ev.q: New Zealand's sheep graze outdoors all year round on grass that grows with little fertiliser

10.why: C段。are able to graze in the open throughout the year ↔ graze outdoors all year round。E 正好相反：新西兰的草几乎不用化肥（with little fertiliser）。

ev.q: tomatoes grown in heated greenhouses in northern Europe during the winter may be responsible for more emissions than tomatoes grown outdoors in Spain and carried north by lorry

11.why: C段。may cause more emissions than produce brought by road from the south ↔ may be responsible for more emissions than tomatoes grown outdoors in Spain and carried north by lorry。by road ↔ by lorry；from the south ↔ Spain … carried north。

ev.q: the products concerned are usually easy to identify, since they tend to be perishable goods on sale outside their normal season

12.why: D段。Perishable goods sold outside their usual season ↔ perishable goods on sale outside their normal season；这类商品正是空运商品的特征 ↔ are likely to have been transported by plane。G（只占全球食品运输的极小份额）说的是 air freight 整体，主语不同。

ev.q: customers valued the conversations they had with producers almost as much as the produce itself

13.why: E段 Okoro 的研究。appreciate talking to growers ↔ valued the conversations they had with producers；almost as much as the food itself ↔ almost as much as the produce itself。

ev.q: tens of thousands of smallholders in East Africa depend on exports of vegetables and flowers to Europe

14.why: F段 Mwangi。rely on selling their crops to Europe ↔ depend on exports of vegetables and flowers to Europe。E 不对：原文说肯尼亚豆类种植 with little machinery or artificial fertiliser，正好相反。
